questions.question: How many days are there from 10 October to 25 October? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Both dates are in the same month, so subtract: 25 minus 10 is 15. There are 15 days.

questions.question: How many days are there from 20 October to 9 December? Show the three parts.
questions.expected_answer: Days left in October: 31 minus 20 is 11. All of November: 30 days. Days in December: 9. 11 plus 30 plus 9 is 50 days.

questions.question: How many days are there from 20 December to 15 January?
questions.expected_answer: Days left in December: 31 minus 20 is 11. Days in January: 15. 11 plus 15 is 26 days.
